target_statement: Derive and audit an exact edge-flux/product-graph reformulation of the hat-versus-natural semiprime discrepancy; do not assert an analytic CA4 estimate.
claim_status_sought: Exact identities, conditional adapters, and scoped proof-class no-go statements only.
trust_model: Exact finite-dimensional algebra plus previously recorded asymptotic prime-gap inputs; synthetic falsifiers remain synthetic.
first_unproved_edge: A translated mixed moment for the exact adjacent-gap flux channel against the positive hat-plus-natural channel.
mask_or_node_class: Exact ordinary-prime shell and retained adjacent-gap nodal-hat probability lambda; eta is a separately passported natural prime probability on the identical shell and taper.
source_data_retained: Predecessor/successor gaps and deletion indicators remain encoded in lambda and hence in the cumulative flux c; they are not replaced by density data.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: lambda and eta are positive probabilities; delta=lambda-eta is signed and zero-mass; all flux and product-kernel signs are retained jointly.
normalization: sum(lambda)=sum(eta)=1, delta=D^*c, and s=lambda+eta has mass 2. Ordered factor matrices are used before the unique-factorization quotient.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Every translated dyadic CA4 window with Y^(1049/1250) <= T <= Y^(50/33); no claim about the one-sided floor is made except through the existing CA4 adapter.
quantifier_order: For each sufficiently large legal Y, lambda, eta, c, and s are fixed before t; estimates would have to hold for every translated legal T-window with one common kernel per window.
resolution_required: Product resolution H=Y^2/T, including H=Y^(16/33) at the upper endpoint. A product edge generated by p_j to p_(j+1) has displacement about Y g_j and normalized length T Delta_j about T g_j/Y.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.generic_product_conductor_deficit: Y^(2-alpha-1/10); at alpha=50/33 this is Y^(127/330)
all_losses: A natural fourth-moment estimate for eta is an independent premise, not proved here.
Termwise absolute recombination is forbidden; the edge and vertex channels must remain joint.
No small edge multiplier is available uniformly above the already-closed transition range.

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: The unique path flux is c_j=-sum_(i<=j)(lambda_i-eta_i); the exact symmetric product flux is nonempty for every pair of probabilities.
downstream_socket: Natural CA4 for eta AND the exact mixed edge-flux moment at the CA4 scale imply CA4 for lambda by polarization and Minkowski.
parallel_open_siblings: The natural eta fourth moment/HL*(4) premise
why_not_target_renamed: Only a theorem with a right side controlled by an independently proved flux norm would be strictly smaller. The bare exact mixed moment is equivalent to the discrepancy norm once the natural premise is granted and must be labeled an interface, not progress.
abstract_convex_falsifier: On a path, image(D^*) is the entire zero-mass subspace, so existence of an edge flux alone imposes no coefficient restriction.
fejer_falsifier: Uniform meshes have exact aliases; discrete derivatives can add coherently even when cumulative transport norms are small.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Reuse the bounded-gap periodic hat/natural motif: it has c-infinity, weighted W1, and product H^-1 norms tending to zero but an order-one mixed semiprime resonance at T about Y/log Y.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: May compare cumulative flux and graph norms at frozen centers, but cannot promote their trend to an asymptotic estimate.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: Any surviving estimate must use non-aliasing/correlation of actual consecutive-prime logarithms while retaining the gap-emptiness selector encoded in c.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: A norm-controlled two-channel edge-vertex theorem plus the natural premise would close CA4 only; LTRAD remains open and the contemplated strip still would not imply RH.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: A no-go for a named transport/Hodge norm eliminates only that proof class, not the exact mixed moment or CA4.
stop_rule: Do not claim a bound; stop if the candidate norm is either not currently bounded at the required power or is falsified by the licensed periodic pseudo-node model.
